groups.intro: Apex Electrical Solutions is a certified dealer of Generac and Kohler generators. Our experienced technicians have extensive industry knowledge and hands-on expertise, so your generator runs smoothly all year round. Backup power keeps the refrigerator, water heater, air conditioning, heating, phone, internet and security systems running through an outage.

services.title: Generator Repair and Diagnostics

plan.name: Electrical Maintenance Plans
plan.intro: An annual electrical inspection that catches a hazard before it becomes a repair. Ask us about the plans, or call 409-996-2739 to sign up.

tiers.name: Basic
features: Annual inspection: tightening and securing of all main and sub-panel connections, GFCI outlets and HVAC disconnects
Detailed report and a quote for any recommended repairs
Annual coverage, so no immediate hazards go unnoticed

tiers.name: Standard
features: Inspection and securing of all panel connections
Thermal imaging to detect overheating issues, with photo documentation
Annual smoke and carbon monoxide detector battery replacement, and smoke detector age checks

tiers.name: Premium
features: Everything in Standard, plus meter analysis, advanced outlet testing and hot tub grounding checks
SureTest analysis for hidden wiring issues, thermal imaging and detailed reporting

plan.note: Our generator preventative maintenance agreement is separate. Call 409-996-2739 for details.

about.title: Providing service since 1995.
text: Apex Electrical Solutions is a family-owned provider of electrical services for League City, Houston and the surrounding areas. The company is led by a Master Electrician, and every job is done by a licensed and insured team.

Alongside the electrical work we are a Master Contractor, licensed to provide general contracting services throughout Texas and Oklahoma, and we offer home renovation services that improve how a house works as well as how it looks.
Whether you need residential, commercial or renovation work, we tailor what we do to what you need. Call 409-996-2739 for a free consultation.
about.imageAlt: A car dealership lot in the evening after a pole lighting upgrade by Apex Electrical Solutions

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: No. Call 409-996-2739 or complete the form and we will give you a free estimate on your project.

faqs.q: Which generator brands do you install and service?
faqs.a: We are a certified dealer of Generac and Kohler generators, and our certified technicians handle installation, repair and year-round service.

Yes. We hold Texas Master Electrician License TMEL# 566066 and Texas Electrical Contractor License TECL# 37045, and we are a Master Contractor licensed for general contracting throughout Texas and Oklahoma.

faqs.q: My EV charger is not working properly. Can you look at it?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer free inspections to find out whether the problem is the car's battery system or the charging station, and then resolve it.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial buildings as well as homes?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover residential and commercial electrical work, from new installations and upgrades to maintenance and emergency repairs.

facts.text: Generator support covers warranties, repairs and routine maintenance. Many generator manufacturers require proof of regular maintenance to keep the warranty valid, so staying on a preventative maintenance plan keeps a future claim covered.

facts.text: Call the office on 409-996-2739, or send your name, email, phone and the time of day you would like a call back - morning, mid-day, afternoon or evening.
